o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (dalġuc); equivalent to dal- (“to dive”) + -ğıc.
Cognate with Turkish dalgıç, compare Gagauz dalgıç.

Ultimately a derivation of Proto-Turkic *tod- (“become satiated, full”) and a doublet of doyğun, therefore equivalent to *tos- + -qun. The first syllable coda /-s/ points towards borrowing of a reflex with a /-ð/, with subsequent devoicing.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قوم (qevm), from Arabic قوم (qawm, “tribe, family”). Doublet of qohum.
Borrowed from Russian электрометаллургия (elektrometallurgija). By surface analysis, elektro- + metallurgiya.
